scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Ah, have you come to
retrieve the memories
lost to you? Yes, you
must be here for the
secrets of life that
were once yours...

[Biochemist]
Close your eyes and
put your mind at rest.
We will return to your
past to recollect the
fragments of your lost
memories.

[Biochemist]
When you open your eyes,
you will clearly remember
the secret of life. You will
also remember the weight of
responsibility in using these
secrets for the right ends...

[Biochemist]
Open your eyes...
Now that you have
remembered how to
create artificial life, I only
ask that you treat all of your
creations with respect.

[Biochemist]
If you wish to
retrieve your lost
memories, please
come back to me.
The secret to creating
life is no trifling thing...

[Biochemist]
It's strange that
someone like me is here.
But even someone skilled
in the ways of science
can manage to be a hero.

[Biochemist]
In this instance,
it's not necessarily
the means I've used, but
the ends for which I've
fought that earned me
a place in Valhalla...

[Biochemist]
Yes...
It's about time.
We need more geniuses
like you on Midgard.

[Biochemist]
Would you like to
become a Biochemist?

[Biochemist]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!

[Biochemist]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.

[Biochemist]
Congratulations!
As a Biochemist,
I hope you use your
vast knowledge for the
right purposes.

[Biochemist]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

[Biochemist]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
